data.title: Application Window Discovery
data.summary: The sample enumerates open application windows and their titles to detect a specific target application running, or to time an input- or screen-capture trigger to that application gaining focus.
data.description:
Window enumeration is a cheap, reliable way to answer 'is the target application open
right now' without needing process-level access: a call to enumerate top-level windows and
match titles against a list (bank names, cryptocurrency exchange names) is sufficient. This
is frequently the trigger condition feeding a focus-based screen or input capture routine
rather than a standalone behaviour.
data.recommendation:
* Recover the window-title match list; it identifies the specific target applications the sample was built to act against.
* Correlate this discovery step with whichever capture routine it feeds (see screen capture, input capture) to understand the complete chain.
* Treat the match list as a strong signal of intended victim profile — consumer banking titles versus enterprise software indicate different targeting.
data.short_recommendation: Recover the window-title match list to identify the specific applications the sample targets and feeds into capture.

mitre_techniques.procedure: Enumerated top-level window titles on a timer and triggered screen capture when a title matched a configured banking-portal list.

mbc_techniques.implementation: Polled window titles against a hardcoded match list to time a focus-triggered capture.
